findings: Actual seed layout is reachable using the frozen policy and ordinary inputs; no demonstrated production geometry/physics defect.
Jet search horizon1.8s models normal group speed/restart acceleration; no Jet rewind occurred before the observed full11 death, so checkpoint restart speed is not implicated by the archive.
Planner hazard collision margin is .35stud more conservative vertically than production BODY; an undersized vertical collision box is ruled out.
The native trace lacks decision intervals, actuation times and Modes vertical velocity, so the exact missed-gate cause remains unproven.
Independent long actuation delay can defeat this policy in a different gate; this does not establish the full11 cause or justify a speculative patch.
